title: Triangular numbers as a function
brief: Implement int triangular(int n) to return 1+2+...+n; keep calculations outside main.
hints: Write a function accepting n.
Use an accumulator starting at zero.
Return the accumulated sum to main.

title: Two sequences, two functions
brief: Keep triangular(n) and add sumSquares(n) for 1²+2²+...+n². Show both results.
hints: Each function computes one sequence.
Inside sumSquares, accumulate i*i.
Print the two results in order.

title: Traverse with a pointer
brief: Read N integers into an array, then sum the values by advancing an int pointer.
hints: Initialize a pointer to the array's first element.
Advance until the end of the array.
Dereference the pointer to read the current value.

title: Pointer output parameters
brief: Implement summarize(const int *a,int n,int threshold,int *sum,int *above). Compute both sum and count of readings strictly greater than threshold.
input: N (1–20), N integers [-100,100], then a threshold [-100,100].
hints: Initialize *sum and *above inside the helper.
Traverse with a const int pointer.
Increment above only for values > threshold.

title: A mirrored word
brief: Determine whether a case-sensitive ASCII word reads the same in reverse.
input: One nonempty ASCII-letter word of length 1–63.
hints: Find the string length.
Compare characters from the two ends.
Stop as soon as a pair differs.

title: Palindrome phrase, ignoring spaces
brief: Read one line of ASCII letters and spaces. Ignore spaces and ASCII case while testing for a palindrome.
input: One line of 1–127 ASCII letters or spaces, with at least one letter.
output: YES if its letters form a palindrome ignoring spaces/case, otherwise NO.
hints: Read the full line using fgets.
Scan inward using left/right indexes, skipping spaces.
Compare corresponding letters using tolower.

title: Best student record
brief: Read an array of struct Student {id,score}. Print the ID of the highest score; choose the earliest record on a tie.
input: N (1–15) followed by N pairs of ID (1–9999) and score (0–100).
hints: Define a struct for each student.
Track the index with greatest score.
Use >, not >=, to preserve the earliest tie.

title: Full class report
brief: Keep the top student's ID, add mean score with two decimals and number of scores at least 50.
input: N (1–15) followed by N pairs of ID (1–9999) and score (0–100).
output: top=ID mean=M passed=P, M with two decimals.
hints: Accumulate scores while reading records.
Count scores >= 50.
Divide by double to retain the decimal mean.

title: Count positives in dynamic storage
brief: Use calloc to allocate N integers, fill them and count strictly positive values. Free the buffer.
hints: Allocate using calloc(N,sizeof(int)).
Check allocation success.
Only values > 0 count.

title: Copy positives to a tight buffer
brief: Retain the count. Allocate a second buffer sized exactly for the positive values (if any); copy and print them in input order.
output: First line positive=N; second line values: followed by positive values with one space before each.
hints: Count first, then allocate exactly that many ints.
For count=0, a second allocation is unnecessary.
Copy in order and free both allocations.
